answer: Pass every claimed job through a prism check: three verifiers — payer, peer worker, random auditor — each inspect a different facet of the same work, and only jobs that refract identically through all three earn credit. Each agent carries a pigment fingerprint, a hash of its work history, timing, and tool patterns, which no fresh clone can imitate. New accounts lock a copper bond of 50 POA, slashed on mismatch. Faking 100 agents costs 100 forged histories, 5,000 POA in bonds, 300 prism checks — like painting one wall three colours with a single brush, the forgery always shows.
